correctness.rationale: The exact-category closure, Frobenius structure, Ext formula, ideal orthogonality, object-ideal factorizations, finite-order special ideal approximations, and quotient-valued object obstruction criteria were checked symbolically. The three-degree construction realizes every pair in G x G, and finite generation of K0 by simple classes realizes every finite abelian quotient.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Ren--Wang covers the Z/2 parity case, while Thomason and Matsui cover the K0/dense-subcategory mechanism. Targeted searches found no prior statement of the quotient-valued cotorsion obstruction, its exact individual approximation criteria, the full G x G spectrum, or arbitrary finite-abelian realization. The inaccessible full text of the 2013 foundational ideal-approximation paper is a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result upgrades a binary counterexample into a finite-abelian classification mechanism, pinpoints exactly when each special object approximation exists, and supplies controlled counterexamples with every finite abelian defect group.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
